scope: Repair the first GitHub CI failures without changing application behavior

frontend.failed_step: Build and run the complete disposable mobile gate
frontend.observation: The first module-reset scenario never observed uploadStarted. The original log does not capture its input or draft-loading state. Installation, audit, dependency consistency, workflow validation and lint passed. Later mobile suites and browser volume were not reached.

backend.failed_step: Check small native PostgreSQL volume with a new owned local cluster
backend.error: OperationalError: (psycopg.OperationalError) connection is bad: service file "" not found
backend.observation: All disposable backend suites passed. PostgreSQL 17.11 started and its identity was verified, but the first review engine connection failed before any volume dataset. The owned cluster was removed.

record_scope: This pre-push record captures the original failure, controlled reproductions, fixes and local validation. GitHub Actions records the remote result for each subsequent commit.

frontend.change: Wait until the selected form is no longer inert before filling its Issue, assert the entered value, and verify the saved answer and photo before the existing upload/session-reset checks.
frontend.regression: Hold the real native draft transaction completion for both original and replacement Workers. Editing must remain pending until release; the complete scenario then preserves the replacement Worker's draft.
frontend.causality_limit: The controlled reproduction reaches the same 30-second timeout through an empty required Issue. The original uninstrumented GitHub timeout remains individually unconfirmed.

backend.change: Keep PGSERVICE and PGSERVICEFILE absent instead of empty, including settings introduced by phase imports or callbacks before an owned connection.
backend.cause: Linux libpq treats empty-but-present service variables as configured values and fails with service file empty-string not found. Windows native environment handling removes empty assignments and masked the defect locally.
backend.regression: Verify inherited settings are removed, import/callback service settings cannot redirect or prevent the owned non-superuser loopback connection, and the caller environment is restored. Run this check after PostgreSQL installation in CI.

validation.owned_cluster_cleanup: confirmed for all local native runs
validation.workflow_syntax: actionlint 1.7.12 passed on Windows; Linux CI additionally runs its available ShellCheck
validation.syntax_and_whitespace: Node syntax, Python compilation and git diff --check passed
validation.independent_review: Both fixes, regressions and CI wiring reviewed without remaining blockers

boundaries: Historical October 12 local validation remains unchanged; it did not establish a remote Ubuntu pass.
No application source was changed, no assertions were removed, and no test timeouts were increased.
No production deployment, migration, hosted application fixture or user-data change is part of this repair.
